temperature.quality_notes: Temperature valid only at measured UTC hours; no filled gaps

pressure.quality_notes: DWD P: sea-level pressure (NN), 950–1065 hPa; <=8 hPa/hour contiguous validation, <=55 hPa per window; never P0 station-height pressure

wind_direction.quality_notes: Wind directions require both hourly mean speeds >=3 m/s; no gusts
